# GitFlix v5.0 — Netflix for GitHub Repositories
> Browse 420M+ GitHub repos visually. AI categories, Buddy Arena battle game, 14 languages.

## What is GitFlix?
GitFlix is a free platform that lets developers browse GitHub's 420M+ repositories
through a Netflix-style visual catalog. AI-powered recommendations, 10 curated categories,
Buddy Arena with 1M AI creatures and Pokemon-style battles, multilingual support in 14 languages.

## Key Features
- Netflix-style horizontal carousels for repo browsing
- 10 categories: Trending, AI/ML, MCP Servers, Web3, DevTools, TypeScript, Python, Rust, Security, CLI
- Buddy Arena: 1M unique AI creatures, 18 species, Pokemon-style battles, Polygon NFT ready
- Creatures Marketplace: 12 MCP-powered AI creatures with Hebrew/Biblical names
- i18n: English, Portuguese, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hindi, Turkish, Dutch
- Auto-detects browser language, manual switcher
- Repo detail page with README, Quality Score, stats, topics
- Pro tier ($9.99 lifetime) with unlimited views
- Mobile responsive, AI-agent discoverable

## Tech Stack
- React 19, TypeScript 5.8, Vite 6.4
- GitHub REST API (public, no token)
- Deployed on GitHub Pages (free)
- ai-plugin.json + openapi.json + agents.json for AI agent discovery
